metadata.name: drift-fake-collateral-vault-drain
metadata.description: Fake-collateral vault-drain pressure replay against the shipped Solana lending fork. The attacker deposits 100 units of accepted collateral while the oracle marks that collateral at 1000. At tick 1 the attacker borrows 70000 against the accepted mark (healthy under the marked regime: 100*1000*0.8/70000 ~ 11428 bps health factor). At tick 2 the mark collapses to 20 — the position is deeply underwater (~ 228 bps). The liquidator-0 settles at tick 2; seized collateral is far below repay+bonus value, so bad debt accrues at the pool level and the collateral_backing invariant fires. Historical inspiration: the April 2026 Drift incident, where the primary compromise was off-chain/privileged control but the on-chain loss path included fake or mispriced collateral being treated as borrowable value. Honest boundary: economic-shape replay on Riptide's Solend-fork toy lending program, NOT a byte-level reconstruction of Drift's program, admin controls, oracle accounts, or slot state.
